title: Exterior Painting in Gainesville, FL | Siding & Stucco
description: Exterior painting in Gainesville, FL for wood siding, stucco, brick, and trim. Mildew wash, rot repair, acrylic or elastomeric coats, up to 10-year warranty.
heroIntro: Gainesville exteriors fail from the bottom edge and the sunny side first. We price and prep each elevation for what it is actually facing, then coat it to last.

sections.h2: Siding, stucco, and brick across Gainesville
body: The exterior of a home in the Duckpond or Pleasant Street districts is usually wood, often with many layers of old paint and plenty of trim detail. NW Gainesville bungalows mix wood or fiber-cement siding with masonry. Newer homes in Haile Plantation, Town of Tioga, and similar communities lean more on stucco and fiber-cement with painted trim.

Each substrate gets its own product: 100% acrylic on siding and trim, elastomeric on stucco with hairline movement, and penetrating stain where bare wood is meant to show. We also coat brick and block with masonry-appropriate systems.

sections.h2: Reading each elevation during the walkthrough
body: A crew lead photographs every side of the house and takes moisture readings where wood looks soft. What they are looking for:
bullets: Chalk on the south and west walls, where sun breaks down the binder fastest
Peeling at the lowest siding boards and door frames from sprinkler spray and splash-back
Mildew and algae on shaded north walls
Open joints around windows, trim, and penetrations
Soft fascia and sills that need replacement before paint

sections.h2: The exterior system, step by step
body: Prep gets its own days on the schedule. The house is washed and mildew is treated, failing paint is scraped back to a tight edge, glossy surfaces are sanded, nail pops are reset, and rot is cut out and replaced. Moving joints are re-caulked with a flexible paintable sealant, and bare wood and stucco hairlines are spot-primed.

Then come two full coats of premium Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore, with a third on dramatic color changes or porous surfaces. Sprayed areas are back-brushed or back-rolled where the coating needs to work into the surface.

October through May is the best window for exterior painting here. During summer we still work outside, but crews start early, track dew point, and watch radar for afternoon storms. A full exterior usually takes three to seven working days plus washing and dry time. For a sense of how long a quality job should last, read how long exterior paint lasts in Florida.

Exterior projects carry a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years in addition to the manufacturer's coverage. You sign the punch walk only after every item is fixed. Pair the job with a soft wash in Gainesville for walkways and drives, or browse the full exterior painting service overview. Our painters in Gainesville page covers the neighborhoods we work in most.

faqs.q: Do you paint stucco homes in Haile Plantation and Town of Tioga?
faqs.a: Yes. Stucco with hairline cracking usually gets an elastomeric coating that bridges small movement. Wider cracks are repaired before coating.

faqs.q: Can you match my community's approved exterior colors?
faqs.a: Yes. We match from a chip or existing surface and can provide drawdowns to support an approval request.

faqs.q: What if you find rotten wood during the job?
faqs.a: Rot found at the walkthrough is priced on the estimate. Anything hidden that turns up later is shown to you and only addressed with your written approval.

faqs.q: How much does exterior painting cost in Gainesville?
faqs.a: We do not publish prices. Cost depends on measured area, condition and prep, product line, access and height, and the number of colors, and the estimate is free.
